cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll bring my completed form tomorrow. You can give me one extra day as a trial.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody has had an extension. Why should I start with you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're welcome to start with me. Write today's deadline beside tomorrow's; I'll bring the form then and we can compare the damage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One day. No more. I'm marking it as an exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Date that note and keep it with the form when I bring it. Next time, bring this trial out before you tell anyone we've never allowed an extra day. We'll have an actual result to discuss.
